parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or Disables Online Sign Up feature on the access point.

parameters.name: SSID
parameters.description: The SSID that the mobile device uses for Online Sign Up with all the Online Sign Up providers listed in {{param|FriendlyNames}}

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: Specifies the list of protocols supported by the Online Sign Up provider as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Table 13-OSU Method values}}.

parameters.name: FriendlyNames
parameters.description: Specifies the list of Online Sign Up Provider names as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Section 4.8.1.1}}.

parameters.name: ServerURIs
parameters.description: Specifies the list of Online Sign Up Server URI as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Section 4.8.1.2}}.

parameters.name: ServiceDescriptions
parameters.description: Specifies the list of Online Sign Up service description as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Section 4.8.1.6}}.

parameters.name: ProviderNAIs
parameters.description: Specifies the list of the Network Access Identifiers that is used for Online Sign Up as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Section 4.13}}.

object.description: This object implements Passpoint Online Sign Up as described in {{bibref|Passpoint|Section 4.3}}.
